'''TK-5861'''<ref name="TOG" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> [[stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. As such, the [[trooper]] was equipped with the [[Stormtrooper armor|standard armor]] and [[E-11 medium blaster rifle|weapon]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="TOG" />
